name: Vagrant boxes
auth: Set ATLAS_TOKEN to a runtime access/reference token. Read permission is required for metadata and box bytes; deploy permission is required for publication. Vagrant may place the token in requests, so redact query strings in diagnostics.
fresh_home: Create a new AW_WORK with mktemp -d for every run; client configuration, downloads and caches in the commands stay under this directory. Do not reuse it to prove a fresh download. Remove the temporary directory after use.
prerequisites: Use the pinned Linux amd64 client; an ARM Docker host needs --platform=linux/amd64.
A valid VirtualBox .box artifact for acme/demo 1.0.0.

configure.code:
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
export VAGRANT_HOME="$AW_WORK/vagrant"
export VAGRANT_SERVER_URL="$AW_URL/artifactory/api/vagrant/$AW_REPO"
export ATLAS_TOKEN="$AW_TOKEN"
export CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1 VAGRANT_CHECKPOINT_DISABLE=1
configure.note: Vagrant sends the runtime access token through its server integration. Use a new VAGRANT_HOME to avoid cached boxes.

publish.note: Vagrant repositories support local and one-node federated classes only; remote and virtual configuration is unsupported.

steps.note: The .box archive must identify the matching provider. Matrix parameters define box identity even when the stored filename differs.

install.note: Install from a local or one-node federated Vagrant repository.

steps.code:
vagrant --no-color box add "$VAGRANT_SERVER_URL/acme/demo" --provider virtualbox --box-version 1.0.0
vagrant --no-color box list
steps.note: This verifies metadata, checksums and installed box bytes; it does not boot a VM.

limitations: No remote or virtual Vagrant repository classes.
Installation/update proof covers box storage; virtualization-provider boot is outside acceptance.

contains: an invalid token cannot install a private Vagrant box
